description: Find requested clause types (confidentiality, indemnification, limitation of liability, ...) in one contract and return the exact clause text with its location.

selection_doc.use_when: A task asks whether a contract contains specific clauses, or needs the verbatim text of named clauses.
selection_doc.do_not_use_when: The task needs a risk opinion, a compliance verdict or a written report.

en: Does this NDA contain a confidentiality clause?
Extract the indemnification clause from this agreement

document.text:
1. Confidentiality
Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information strictly confidential.

2. Term
This Agreement lasts two years.
